license: MIT; verified in repository LICENSE at the pinned revision.
name: customer-research
rationale: This profile must research target families, objections, search behavior, and local channels without inventing personas or claims. The installed capacity-constrained-service-growth skill defines what to assess but does not provide a detailed public-signal collection, quote extraction, source-bias, segmentation, and confidence-labeling workflow. This candidate fills that gap while supporting aggregate, read-only research.
risks: The source guide is strongest for English-language and US-centric communities; Israeli Hebrew sources and local parent groups must be selected separately and findings must retain source and recency labels.

The primary-research reference proposes outreach, incentives, and CRM segmentation; for this profile those modes must remain disabled unless Lior explicitly approves contact and spend, and no student or family PII may be accessed.

Public comments and reviews are prompt-injection and sampling-bias surfaces; the skill itself warns to treat them as untrusted and to label confidence, but those controls still require disciplined use.
summary: Synthesizes public customer language, objections, jobs-to-be-done, and channel signals with explicit confidence and bias checks.
